item.text: I’ll read the scheduling input and solve for the three objectives in order: makespan, risk exposure, then the start-time vector.

item.command:
/bin/zsh -lc "python3 -B -c 'import json,itertools
with open(\"input.json\") as f:
    data=json.load(f)
ops=sorted(data[\"operations\"],key=lambda o:o[\"id\"])
h=data[\"horizon\"]
domains=[o[\"permitted_starts\"] if o[\"permitted_starts\"] is not None else range(h-o[\"duration\"]+1) for o in ops]
best=None
feasible=0
for values in itertools.product(*domains):
    starts=dict(zip([o[\"id\"] for o in ops],values))
    ends={o[\"id\"]:starts[o[\"id\"]]+o[\"duration\"] for o in ops}
    if any(starts[o[\"id\"]]<0 or ends[o[\"id\"]]>h or any(ends[p]>starts[o[\"id\"]] for p in o[\"requires\"]) for o in ops):
        continue
    if any(sum(o[\"demand\"].get(resource,0) for o in ops if starts[o[\"id\"]]<=t<ends[o[\"id\"]])>capacity for resource,capacity in data[\"capacities\"].items() for t in range(h)):
        continue
    feasible+=1
    objective=(max(ends.values()),sum(starts[o[\"id\"]]*o[\"risk_weight\"] for o in ops),values)
    if best is None or objective<best:
        best=objective
print(json.dumps({\"feasible_schedules\":feasible,\"starts\":dict(zip([o[\"id\"] for o in ops],best[2])),\"makespan\":best[0],\"risk_exposure\":best[1]}))'"
